annotations.title: Research one question in one call

description: One private markets question in one call: BDC and private credit lenders, borrowers, loans, maturities and non-accrual, sponsors, advisers, teams, pension commitments. Reads SEC filings (BDC schedules, Form ADV, IAPD) and plan documents; returns entities, an answer from cited claims only, coverage limits, withheld counts. identify and screen depth are free. Paged by continuation. No model inside.

as_of.description: Optional ISO date the answer is read as of (default: today).

continue.description: page.continuation from a previous answer: returns its next page, read through this caller's own access. Pages split between whole claims, never inside one.

depth.description: identify: ids only (up to 6 reads, 3 KB). screen: the primary read at the latest date (8 reads, 8 KB). investigate (default): every date and section the question needs (14 reads, 12 KB a page). validate: investigate plus cross-checks, disagreements under contradictions (18 reads). monitor: changes since `since` or 90 days, with a checkpoint (8 reads). Without a paid DFX plan or the 7 day trial, identify and screen run and an unnamed depth runs at screen.

detail.description: compact: identity, the answer, its basis claims and counts, under 2 KB. research (default): the page in full.

entity.description: Optional. The subject: a name (firm, fund, company, plan, advisor) or a DFX id (dfx:<graph>:<id>). Without it, every entity is read from the question.

question.description: The question in plain language, as an analyst would ask it.

since.description: Optional ISO date: the window start (depth=monitor: the checkpoint).

workflow.description: Optional hint. credit_by_sponsor: BDC lenders, positions, facilities and sponsors. advisor_movement: IAPD registration moves, people and teams. allocator_to_company: plan commitments and capital paths. Without it, the workflow is read from the question's words.

name: research

answer.description: text, basis (claim ids on this page), state

claims.description: every claim the rows on this page carry (lane I1's claims.research_claims): claim_id (content addressed: subject, predicate, object, value, date, source), row, predicate, claim_type, evidence_status, entitlement_class, derived_from; the subject, value, dates and citation are on the row it names

identities.description: the subject, every other entity resolved, candidates

page.description: index, rows and claims on this page and in all, rows after it, continuation

plan.description: workflow, operation, depth, the operations run and the budget

revisit.description: how to come back to this answer: for a key whose plan includes watches, one watch_create call that saves the question; otherwise what that needs, plus meanwhile_call (a free search_private_credit_changes call on the subject since the answer's as_of) where this profile lists that tool. Private credit subjects only; absent when it does not apply

state.description: OK, NO_MATCH, NOT_COVERED, UNKNOWN, or an error state

usage.description: operations run, budget, bytes, latency; no model call

title: Research one question in one call
